signature: SUBROUTINE DPBEQU( UPLO, N, KD, AB, LDAB, S, SCOND, AMAX, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kd
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of subdiagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KD} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: The upper or lower triangle of the symmetric band matrix A, stored in the first `KD`+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(kd+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{kd}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kd})$.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KD}+1$.

params.name: s
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, S contains the scale factors for A.

params.name: scond
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, S contains the ratio of the smallest `S(i)` to the largest `S(i)`. If $\mathrm{SCOND} \ge 0.1$ and `AMAX` is neither too large nor too small, it is not worth scaling by S.

params.name: amax
params.reference: Absolute value of largest matrix element. If `AMAX` is very close to overflow or very close to underflow, the matrix should be scaled.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the i-th diagonal element is nonpositive.
